steamcore.configuration.enableWipItems.t: Enables Work In Progress items in the creative tab and JEI/EMI
steamcore.configuration.showIntroMessage: Shows story messages in chat when joining a world. (Not ready)
steamcore.configuration.enableSteamDebug: Enables /steamdebug. Commands: info, ping, abysstp, setenergy, packinfo, modlist.
steamcore.configuration.enableAbyss.tool: Enables the teleport system when falling into the void in the Overworld.
steamcore.configuration.disassemblyFailC: Chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an item component is lost during disassembly.
steamcore.configuration.abyssHeight.tool: The Y level at which the player is consumed by the Abyss.
steamcore.configuration.abyssDamage.tool: Amount of magic damage dealt to the player before teleportation.
steamcore.configuration.enablePortals.to: Allows the creation of Nether portals. If false, portals cannot be lit.
steamcore.configuration.showMenuButton.t: Shows the SteamCreate 2 info button on the main menu
steamcore.configuration.enableUpdateNoti: Show a pop-up notification when a modpack update is available

steamcore.update.toast.title: SteamCreate 2
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.intro.awaken: You're awake. Good. The Paradox destroyed your old world. To give it a chance, gather boss fragments and forge the Eternal Core. I'll send you down, but first choose how harsh the journey should be.
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.intro.diffic: Enable enemy progression? Hostile mobs will grow stronger as you defeat bosses, and Nether and End creatures start at higher levels. You can change this choice later.
message.steamcore.mechanic_beacon: The beacon pulls you toward the Mechanic's workshop.
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.main.speaker: The Mechanic
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.main.welcome: Back again. The workshop is holding together. What do you want to know?
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.main.core.te: The Eternal Core is the only thing that can resist the Paradox. Its recipe will bring together fragments taken from powerful bosses. We still need to discover the structure that can awaken it.
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.main.paradox: The Paradox folded cause into effect until our world could no longer exist. I don't know who made it. The journals scattered through the ruins may tell us more.
dialogue.steamcore.mechanic.main.progres: As the world changes, stronger enemies may appear. You can turn that system on or off here.
screen.steamcore.awakening.title: CLOUDS ABOVE THE RUINS
